figures.finding: Grenada reported that children under fifteen may work only once licensed by the Ministry of Labour (the Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Act, Cap. 90, which layer 3 reads, sets fourteen as the child's age).

sources.said: Children under the age of 15 are only allowed to work once they have received a licence to do so from the Ministry of Labour.

figures.finding: Grenada's age of majority is eighteen: from eighteen a person has full legal capacity in civil matters without a parent's or guardian's consent or a court's permission, may hold property and make any contract, for services among them, and every law or rule of common law that required twenty-one or any age above eighteen is read down to eighteen (Age of Civil Legal Responsibility Act 2011, ss. 3-5).

value.law: Age of Civil Legal Responsibility Act, Cap. 4A, s. 3

sources.said: any person who attains the age of eighteen years, shall be of the age of full civil legal responsibility and thus have full legal capacity to deal with civil matters without needing the consent of his parents or guardians, or the permission of any court of law, on account only of his age.
